description: PR876 inline comments 4501506622 and 4501513062: normalize/validate supplied max_file_size for every provider. Declare configurable_max_file_size in channel registration and project through existing capability snapshot; BO fields depend on that signal and use generic wording/IDs. Existing Bridge.provider_config and snapshot dispatch reused, no new Action or provider branch. Test supported non-Mattermost, unsupported Mattermost, validation and persistence.
title: Make upload size configuration capability-driven
